title: Grime
style: UK pop rap, melodic rap, R&B hook, rap‐sung chorus, trio vocals, call‐and‐response, catchy chant hook, ad‐lib heavy, autotune accents, emotional storytelling, nostalgic 90s UK, grime‐pop fusion, UK garage bounce, 2‐step groove, club anthem, radio‐ready polish, stacked harmonies, urban strings, piano stabs, synth stabs, punchy claps and 808s, minor‐key drama, halftime bridge switch, 130‐140 BPM, youthful street energy, anthemic crowd vocals
lyrics:
[Intro – Ad‐libs] Yeah, yeah... turn it up Ayy, ayy... press play (Who raised you?) Rain and tape (Where we from?) UK

[Verse 1 – Rap] Weeknights, blue lights on the lounge wall still, Theme tune hummin’, whole fam quiet on The Bill. Mum’s brave eyes, bills on the fridge, chill, Turn the telly up when the house goes still. Back of the Sky box, card in the slot, Jiggle that SCART lead—picture or not. Footy on mute when the clouds got thick, Borrowed signal, borrowed time, make it stick. Game Boy glow under duvet caves, Pixels like candles when the tide misbehaves. Dial‐up scream covers raised voices, Count 1471, pretend I’ve choices. Jumpers for goalposts, concrete pitch, Skinned knees, big dreams, life’s switch. Woolies on Saturdays—ten p treats, Pocket money miracles, rain‐soaked streets.

[Pre‐Chorus – Sung] Tape the charts off the radio, pause on the breath, Pray the DJ don’t talk over the best. Ceefax holidays we circled in pen, Not for us—kept the hope for then. I learned patience from the hiss in the line, Turned my pain into punchlines, time after time.

[Chorus – Viral Hook (Sung, stacked harmonies)] Rewind, press play—UK ’90s made me, Streetlights my timeline, rainclouds raised me, Tape‐hiss patience—no skip could save me, Say it with your chest: you can’t remake me. Rewind, press play—we learned the hard way, Bus‐stop confessions, not a For‐You hallway, No cloud to hold us, just memory and heartache, UK ’90s made me—won’t be remade. (Made me... made me... UK ’90s made me...)

[Post‐Chorus – Chant/Ad‐libs] Press play, press play (ayy), UK made me (yeah) No Wi‐Fi, just why‐try—rain days shaped me Hands high—warehouse saved me Say it in caps: UK ’90s made me

[Verse 2 – Rap] Pub carpet galaxies, fruit‐machine glare, I’m sat with a Coke while the pints clack there. Back‐room skittle alley, pins clap wood, Mum chalks a line, Dad nods—both good. Vinegar fog round chips on plates, Laugh through the week till the weekend waits. Meat man strides in, cooler‐bag grin, “Roasting joints, two for a tenner—who’s in?” I’m jukebox rich with a pocket of change, Pick sad then sweet—make the room rearrange. Outside, baccy smoke writes crooked psalms, Inside, I pocket the calm in my palms. Dodgy Sky, rainy nights, pirate feeds, Panini ’98 swaps—shiny needs. I learned timing from a skittle lane, And how to stitch a laugh through pain.

[Pre‐Chorus – Sung] Argos pens in a pocket of schemes, Blue Peter glue for the split‐seam dreams. If hope’s a bus, I’ll leg it uphill, If fear’s a voice, I’ll drown it with will.

[Chorus – Viral Hook (Sung, bigger)] Rewind, press play—UK ’90s made me, Streetlights my timeline, rainclouds raised me, Tape‐hiss patience—no skip could save me, Say it with your chest: you can’t remake me. Rewind, press play—we learned the hard way, Bus‐stop confessions, not a For‐You hallway, No cloud to hold us, just memory and heartache, UK ’90s made me—won’t be remade. (Made me... made me... UK ’90s made me...)

[Bridge – Sung/Rap switch, emotional lift] Behind the bike sheds we held our wakes, Tamagotchis gone, little plastic aches. Furby at 3am, eyes glow red, I said silly words, felt something said. If pain is homework, I filled that book, If luck’s a number, I changed that look. From Ceefax scores to split‐screen nights, Four pads, one telly—young streetlights.

[Breakdown Hook – Call & Response] Say “Rewind!” — Rewind! Say “Press Play!” — Press Play! Say “UK!” — UK! Say “’90s made me!” — ’90s made me! No stream, no skip—just grit and bravery, Type it in caps: UK ’90s made me!

[Final Chorus – Key up, stacked harmonies, ad‐libs] Rewind, press play—UK ’90s made me, Streetlights my timeline, rainclouds raised me, Tape‐hiss patience—no skip could save me, Say it with your chest: you can’t remake me. Rewind, press play—we learned the hard way, Bus‐stop confessions, not a For‐You hallway, No cloud to hold us, just memory and heartache, UK ’90s made me—won’t be remade. (Made me... made me... UK ’90s made me...) You can’t remake me (no), you can’t remake me (nah), UK ’90s made me.

[Outro – Ad‐libs] Press play... let it ride Rain and tape... we survived From flats to stage—same heart, new page UK ’90s made me
